item.tib: zhi ba g.yung drung yongs su rdzogs pa'i chog khrigs phrin las me tog phreng rgyan
item.coloph: zhi ba g.yung drung yongs su rdzogs pa'i chog khrigs phrin las me tog phreng rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gshen dam pa rgyal tshab pa'i phyag len la brten nas/ gshen gyi btsun pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi (gyis/)dpal dar lding ri rgyal dgon rtser sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
